fact: The Ministry of Health's Health Information and Documentation Center published its Annual Statistical Report 2022, built from routine health facility data entered in DHIS2 and from births and deaths 2014-2021 supplied by the Civil Registry Authority, and states the center has issued annual statistical reports since 2006 (reports for 2019 and 2020 issued in 2022).
title: التقرير الإحصائي السنوي 2022
publisher: وزارة الصحة - مركز المعلومات والتوثيق الصحي
